name: public-claude-skills
description: Two Claude Code skills: site-admin and media-gen.

plugins.name: site-admin
plugins.description: The same /admin on every one of your websites: per-person sign-in with roles, resets and an activity log, analytics, a forms inbox, a Setup tab that connects Stripe, email, MailerLite and spam protection with live checks, and optional modules. Ships a tested kit for Cloudflare Pages on D1 or Supabase, and notes for KV and Next.js.

plugins.name: media-gen
plugins.description: AI images, image-to-video and Topaz upscaling through Fal.ai, pay per use, saved to a local folder. Needs your own Fal API key and: pip install fal-client==1.0.3. Video spends are blocked until you approve the quoted price.
